202610066713015.description:
2016 Auto-Trail Tribute 670 - 2.3 Diesel Manual
A practical and versatile 2-berth campervan, 4 belted seats that has been thoughtfully set up for travelling, family adventures and off-grid camping.
The van has had three owners from new and has been part of our family for a number of years, including being owned by my late mother. It has been well used, enjoyed and cared for, and we are now looking for a new owner to continue enjoying it.
It has also had additional work carried out to reinforce the rear shock absorbers, adding to the practical upgrades already made to the van.
**Sleeping & living space**
The rear has been modified away from a typical T670 and closer to an expedition  68 -to create a fixed bed with a large garage/storage area underneath. The garage is particularly useful for bikes, outdoor equipment, surfboards, camping gear and general storage.
Although officially a 2-berth, we also have a Cabbunk system which fits onto the front swivel cab seats and provides sleeping space for two children up to 70kg it could be considered a 4-berth.
There is also a dining table and the van has 4 travelling seats with seat belts, making it practical for travelling with a family.

Auto-Sleeper Kemerton XL – 2021 Motorhome
If you're after a motorhome that's genuinely set up for extended trips and off-grid stays, this 2021 Auto-Sleeper Kemerton XL is well worth a proper look. Built on the Fiat Ducato base, it comes ready with a roof-mounted solar panel and a self-seeking satellite dome already fitted, plus built-in WiFi — the kind of kit that normally gets added on afterwards, already sorted for you here.
This pre-owned example carries a manual gearbox, so it drives in the traditional way many motorhome owners are used to. It sits within reach of a standard UK licence for most drivers, and the extra-long Ducato base gives a genuinely usable amount of internal space without feeling unwieldy on site. Measuring approximately 7.65 meters in length, its standout feature is a rear "island" drop-down bed that descends electrically over a cozy, multi-aspect lounge, allowing the space to function as a private living room by day and a luxury master suite by night.
The interior is defined by Bürstner’s Thermo-Floor—a level, double-floor construction that ensures a flush walking surface from the cab to the bedroom while providing excellent winter insulation. Moving forward from the rear lounge, you’ll find a spacious washroom with a separate shower cubicle, followed by an L-shaped kitchen equipped with soft-close drawers and high-end "Fenix" anti-scratch surfaces. The front of the vehicle houses a second seating area with a swivel table that can be topped by an optional second drop-down bed, making it a flexible choice for both couples seeking extra space or families needing four berths.
